dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, how did you and Mark meet?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈhaʊ dɪd juː ənd ˈmɑːrk ˈmiːt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: We met at a friend's party last year. He asked me out the next day.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈmɛt ət ə ˈfrɛndz ˈpɑːrti ˈlæst ˈjɪr. hiː ˈæskt miː ˈaʊt ðə ˈnɛkst ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's fast! Where did you go on your first date?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈfæst! ˈwɛr dɪd juː ˈɡoʊ ɑːn jʊr ˈfɜːrst ˈdeɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: We went to a night market and ate street food.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈwɛnt tu ə ˈnaɪt ˌmɑːrkɪt ənd ˈeɪt ˈstriːt ˌfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How romantic! Did you fall in love quickly?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ roʊˈmæntɪk! dɪd juː ˈfɔːl ɪn ˈlʌv ˈkwɪkli?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No. That happened later, when I had the flu.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ðæt ˈhæpənd ˈleɪtər, wɛn aɪ ˈhæd ðə ˈfluː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: He looked after me for a week. He cooked for me and brought me medicine.
dialogue.reading: hiː ˈlʊkt ˈæftər miː fər ə ˈwiːk. hiː ˈkʊkt fər miː ənd ˈbrɔːt miː ˈmɛdəsən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's sweet. He really cares about you.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈswiːt. hiː ˈriːli ˈkɛrz əˈbaʊt juː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know. That's why this fight is so hard.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. ðæts ˈwaɪ ˈðɪs ˈfaɪt ɪz ˈsoʊ ˈhɑːrd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Do you think he'll propose one day?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈθɪŋk hiːl prəˈpoʊz ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Propose? We're too young! First, I need to make up with him.
dialogue.reading: prəˈpoʊz? wɪr ˈtuː ˈjʌŋ! ˈfɜːrst, aɪ ˈniːd tə ˈmeɪk ˈʌp wɪð hɪm.
